text:
kevin: heads up — ap-south-2 dedicated pool is exhausted. queue shows ~240 waiting, autoscaler requests timing out. fallback routing kicked in and we're spilling to hosted. seeing p95 climb and cost spike. anyone oncall?
sasha: oncall here, I'm looking. autoscaler logs first. did we get any unusual batch jobs or partner bursts?
maria: I pushed a routing tweak this morning for partner-b to route 60% through dedicated for lower latency — could be amplification.
aj: if autoscaler is failing, check controller logs: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/dedicated-autoscaler --since=15m`
infra-bot: ALERT: metric(dedicated-pool-ap-south-2.gpu_util) = 98% > threshold(90%). fallback policy `dedicated-fallback-v2` engaged, routing ~45% -> hosted.
sasha: autoscaler calls to the cluster API are getting 503/timeouts to the zonal metadata service. scaling API calls fail after 10s. looks like nodepool control plane flake.
rachel: hosted team — can we temporarily raise hosted pool quota? fallback is putting pressure on us. I'll open the request and ping them.
kevin: cost estimate for current overflow is ~ $2.4k/hr if this runs for >1h. proposal: throttle non-critical customers and revert maria's partner-b routing change immediately.
maria: rolling back partner-b now: `./scripts/route-edit --env prod --service partner-b --set dedicated_pct=20` — will monitor.
aj: sasha, can you paste `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=autoscaler -o wide` output?
sasha: ```
NAME                                  READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
autoscaler-5c7f9d8f7b-kz2xh           0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   4          12m
autoscaler-5c7f9d8f7b-rm4pq           1/1     Running            0          2m
```
sasha: digging deeper — kubelet on nodepool ap-south-2-c failed to register after a kernel update at 03:12 UTC. nodes were cordoned during the upgrade and some didn't come back. that explains scaling timeout.
rachel: hosted team acknowledged emergency quota bump. they can add +20% capacity in ~5-10m and are watching for overload on metro hosted pools. also increased temporary rate-limit for partner-b rollback window.
kevin: plan: (1) keep fallback to hosted while nodes recover, (2) once autoscaler has 3 healthy pods and nodepool is stable, run a canary: route 30% -> dedicated, (3) monitor p95/errors for 10m before increasing. sasha — you coordinate canary.
sasha: autoscaler restarted and second pod is healthy. initiating canary: `routing set ap-south-2 canary=30%`
infra-bot: INFO: routing change applied for ap-south-2: dedicated=30%, hosted=70%. monitoring p95, error-rate, queue-depth.
kevin: p95 trending back to baseline and queues are draining. cost is still elevated; open a Jira for RCA and add policy to block nodepool upgrades during peak windows.
maria: :thumbsup: will follow up with partner-b to smooth traffic spikes and add client-side backoff.
kevin: closing this thread once queue < 10 and autoscaler stable for 30m. thanks all.
